messages:
emily_g: Quick sync — Acme Health POC. Key asks: PHI-safe handling, ~30k context for long clinical notes, embeddings + rerank for search, and tool-calls into their EHR. Need: model rec, success criteria, timeline, and security Q answers. Kickoff tomorrow? cc @raj_p @zach_dev @maria_cs @tim_sales

raj_p: On model selection: recommend testing our 32k context variant (quantized) + a smaller 8k baseline. Candidate models: redwood-32k (if available) and a 70B-32k open model. Need perf/latency evals to compare.

zach_dev: Proposal for evals: 1) structured summarization on 20 de-id notes, 2) end-to-end QA that exercises tool-calls to EHR APIs, 3) search+rerank with embeddings. I'll sketch prompts + metrics and run baseline.

maria_cs: Security checklist heads-up: they require SOC2, SAML/SCIM SSO, data residency in us-east, BAA for PHI, KMS integration, and no persisted PHI in hosted logs. If they require air-gapped/on-prem we need Private. @sec_bot can you point to docs?

sec_bot: Security pack link: https://redwood.internal/sec/acme-pack — includes BAA template, KMS integrations, audit log retention options. Short: hosted can be HIPAA-compatible with BAA + KMS + logging configs, but private deployment is recommended for strict PHI regimes.

tim_sales: Pricing question from client: what is delta for Dedicated reserved vs Hosted (token cost) and what's platform fee for Private? They also asked about minimum commit for Dedicated.

raj_p: Short answer: Hosted: standard per-token. Dedicated: ~25-35% discount depending on commit and GPU class, plus reserved monthly commitment. Private: platform license + ops support fee + infra cost. I'll put numbers in a follow-up doc but need the expected qps and monthly token volume.

zach_dev: Quick eval prompt (example):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the patient's most recent visit focusing on meds and follow-ups. Output JSON: {meds:[], follow_up:[]}"
Context: 15-20 clinical notes (de-identified)
Metrics: exactness for meds (precision/recall), hallucination check, latency @ 8k vs 32k
```
I'll run this on 10 test cases to start.

maria_cs: Also confirm: they want explicit statement that KV-cache won't persist PHI beyond request lifetime and that logs can be disabled/filtered. They added SCIM for provisioning and audit log retention 1 year. If hosted cannot meet any, legal will push dedicated/private.

emily_g: Timeline: client asked for a 2-week POC: week 1 ingest + baseline evals (8k & 32k), week 2 integrate EHR toolcall flow + rerank. Is that feasible?

raj_p: 2 weeks is aggressive but doable if we get sanitized sample data today and SCIM/SAML details this morning. Note: 32k runs will increase latency — we should report tail latency and p99.

zach_dev: Rerank plan: embeddings -> FAISS -> neural reranker (lightweight). We'll test both approximate vs exact retrieval and report latency/throughput and rerank delta in MRR/NDCG. Also test memory/FAISS sizing for 30k contexts.

maria_cs: Potential blockers: if they insist on air-gapped deployment or non-export of any model weights (some legal asks), POC becomes on-prem and timeline slips to 4+ weeks. Also need clarity on what qualifies as PHI in their dataset.

tim_sales: 👍 I'll ask client to drop a sanitized sample and confirm SCIM requirement now. Will update by EOD.

emily_g: Action items: raj -> pricing doc & commit options; zach -> eval harness + initial prompts & run; maria -> fill security questionnaire answers and flag blockers; tim -> confirm data sample and SCIM. We'll reconvene after initial runs. Keep updates here.
